In a CryptoQuant Quicktake post, an analyst has discussed the Spent Output Profit Ratio (SOPR) of the Bitcoin short-term holders. The SOPR refers to an indicator that tells us whether the BTC investors are selling their coins at a profit or loss.

entry.title: Roland Emmerich Chats New Sci-Fi Show 'Space Nation,' Bitcoin, and AI
entry.summary:
Roland Emmerich and Marco Weber join Decrypt to discuss their in development TV show based on crypto game 'Space Nation Online.'
Emmerich, who will executive produce the upcoming series, is known as the director of Independence Day, The Day After Tomorrow, Stargate, and 2012. As such, many have nicknamed him the 'master of disaster.' Joining him as executive producer is Weber who produced of Igby Goes Down as well as The Thirteenth Floor.
